sql: WITH thursdays AS ( SELECT trip_date, trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE d_dow = 4 AND trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28' ), weather AS ( SELECT obs_date, prcp_mm FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily ), holidays AS ( SELECT holiday_date FROM whybot.us_holidays WHERE is_national = true ) SELECT t.trip_date, t.trips, w.prcp_mm, CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'federal_holiday' ELSE 'non_holiday' END AS holiday_status FROM thursdays t LEFT JOIN weather w ON w.obs_date = t.trip_date LEFT JOIN holidays h ON h.holiday_date = t.trip_date WHERE w.prcp_mm > 20 AND h.holiday_date IS NULL ORDER BY t.trip_date LIMIT 50
